;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram]]
**Three [[Boko Haram]] suicide bombers [[2019 Borno bombings|detonate their devices]] among a group of football fans, killing 30 people and wounding 40 others, in [[Konduga]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48660150 (BBC News)]
**Boko Haram terrorists exchange gunfire with Nigerian troops in the [[Nganzai]] local government area of [[Borno State]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/nigeria-villagers-borno-mourn-dead-lament-state-failures-190618120652822.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**Acting [[United States Secretary of Defense]] [[Patrick M. Shanahan]] authorizes the deployment of approximately 1,000 additional [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. troops]] to the [[Middle East]] region "for defensive purposes to address air, naval and ground-based threats" amid increased tensions with [[Iran]]. The move comes four days after two oil tankers were attacked in the [[June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident|Gulf of Oman incident]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/military/u-s-sending-1-000-troops-middle-east-amid-heightened-n1018556 (NBC News)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-sending-1000-more-troops-to-middle-east-amid-tensions-with-iran-announced-today-2019-06-17/ (CBS News)]

;Arts and culture
*Japanese [[anime]] developers report that the industry is in crisis, even as its popularity soars in its native country. Among the reasons are low pay, long hours, and a huge shortage of artists &ndash; just as its global popularity reaches record levels. [https://japantoday.com/category/entertainment/japan's-anime-industry-in-crisis-even-as-its-popularity-soars (''Japan Today'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Sichuan earthquake]]
**A magnitude 5.8 [[earthquake]] hits [[Sichuan]], [[China]], killing 13 people and injuring 199 others. [http://chinaplus.cri.cn/news/china/9/20190618/304559.html (China Plus)]

;Health and environment
* [[2019 Bihar encephalitis outbreak]]
** The death toll of [[India|Indian]] children who have died due to an [[acute encephalitis syndrome]] [[outbreak]] reaches 100. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-48610932 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|Iran nuclear deal]]
**[[Iran]] announces that within ten days, it will stop abiding by the agreement and will  exceed the limit on its stockpile of uranium. [https://www.npr.org/2019/06/17/733327050/iran-says-it-will-exceed-nuclear-deals-limit-on-uranium-in-10-days (NPR)]
**[[President of Iran|Iranian President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] tells the [[Fars News Agency]] "the time is short for [[Europe]] to save the international nuclear deal", and calls on [[France]] to take the lead. [[Reuters]] reports that Rouhani added the collapse of the nuclear deal would not be in the interests of the region and the world. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-rouhani/iran-says-time-is-short-for-europe-to-save-nuclear-deal-fars-idUSKCN1TI10O (Reuters)] [https://www.npr.org/2019/06/17/733327050/iran-says-it-will-exceed-nuclear-deals-limit-on-uranium-in-10-days (NPR)]
*[[Ecuador–United States relations]]
**Ecuador agrees to allow U.S. military planes fighting drug trafficking to operate from [[San Cristóbal Airport]] in the [[Galápagos Islands]]. [[National Assembly (Ecuador)|National Assembly]] legislators call on Defense Minister Oswaldo Jarrin and Environmental Minister Marcelo Mata to explain the scope of co-operation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48663283 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Dallas courthouse shooting]]
**A gunman opens fire on [[Dallas Police Department|Dallas police]] before being shot and killed near a federal building. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/17/us/dallas-police-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Gerrymandering in the United States]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] rules, in a 5–4 decision, the Virginia legislative districts that the court previously said were racially gerrymandered, have to remain in their redrawn form. Justices [[Ruth Bader Ginsburg]], [[Sonia Sotomayor]], [[Elena Kagan]], [[Clarence Thomas]] and [[Neil Gorsuch]] make up the majority, not the usual conservative-liberal grouping. [https://www.npr.org/2019/06/17/733389132/supreme-court-hands-democrats-a-win-on-racial-gerrymandering-in-virginia (NPR)]
*Criminal charges are stayed against [[Jaspal Atwal]], the central figure of controversy that surrounded [[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]]'s trip to [[India]]. He was charged in May 2018 with uttering threats against a Punjabi radio host. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/criminal-charges-stayed-against-controversial-figure-jaspal-atwal-1.5178717 (CBC News)]
*Twelve people are killed and dozens more injured when a passenger grabs the steering wheel of a bus in [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]], causing it to crash. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48663063 (BBC News)]
*A man identified as Yujiro Iimori, who allegedly stabbed and robbed a [[police officer]] of his gun, is arrested in [[Osaka]], Japan. He presents a mental health certificate as defense. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/06/17/national/crime-legal/man-sought-stabbing-osaka-police-officer-steal-pistol-apprehended/#.XQe_j7xKjcc (''The Japan Times'')]
*Four people are shot and injured at a parade celebrating the [[2019 NBA Finals]] in [[Toronto]]. [https://globalnews.ca/news/5400259/shooting-toronto-raptors-championship-parade/ (Global News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**The Venezuelan government releases deputy [[Gilber Caro]], who had been detained for three months. [https://www.voanoticias.com/a/venezuela-liberan-al-diputado-opositor-gilbert-caro/4963220.html (VOA)]
*Former [[President of Egypt|Egyptian president]] [[Mohamed Morsi]], who was ousted in a coup in 2013 and has been detained in jail since then, dies after fainting during an espionage court hearing. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/06/17/middleeast/mohamed-morsy-dies-egypt-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://kxlf.com/cnn-europe-mideast-africa/2019/06/17/mohamed-morsy-fast-facts/ (KNIF)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48668941 (BBC News)]
